name: Polars
description: A fast DataFrame library for Rust and Python.
summary: All AI use must be disclosed with the tools used, AI-generated code must be fully tested by a human and is only accepted for accepted issues, and AI may not be used on good first issues. Agents may not interact with the repository at all, and AI-assisted issues and discussions must be reviewed and edited by a human.

evidence.quote: Agents are strictly forbidden from interacting with our repository.
All AI usage in any form must be disclosed.
AI-generated code must have been fully verified with human use.
Pull requests with AI-generated code can only be for accepted issues.
Issues and discussions can use AI assistance but must have a full human-in-the-loop.
This means that any content generated with AI must have been reviewed and edited by a human before submission.
